Container.Name: httpsms-web
Container.Overview: httpSMS web UI (static Nuxt build served by nginx). All settings (API_BASE_URL, APP_URL, FIREBASE_*) are baked in at image build time from web/.env, so there are no runtime variables here. Edit deploy/web.env in the harikiran-lab/httpsms fork and push to rebuild.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the web UI (nginx listens on 3000 inside the container)
